ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (20) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form); blocks 2, 3 had no website counterpart and were translated fresh.

«Мясо» (myaso, 'meat, flesh') is 'flesh' in the opening thought (after Lamartine), so that human and animal flesh stay parallel, and 'meat' in the ordinary vegetarian sense; Zimmerman's «трупы» (trupy) is 'corpses', and «земнородные» (zemnorodnye, 'earth-born') animals are kept literal. Lamartine's «ибо в ней жизнь» (ibo v ney zhizn', 'for in it is life', of blood) is restored where the website draft had 'for it is life'.
Source observation: [2] «чувствоват» lacks its final soft sign (for «чувствовать», 'to feel'); translated as 'feel'.
